name: Pedestrians Walk Facing Traffic
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend WALK ON LEFT FACING TRAFFIC
meaning: Where there is no sidewalk, walk on the left so you face oncoming cars.

snippets.back: If you must walk, carry a light and walk on the left edge facing traffic, and place flares or reflectors one hundred to five hundred feet behind the car on the right edge.
Pedestrians must use an available sidewalk; without one, walk on the shoulder facing traffic and as far from the roadway as possible.
Have the keys ready, approach while facing traffic, and adjust the seat and mirrors before beginning the trip.

If you must leave a broken-down vehicle, lock it and return as soon as practicable, walk facing traffic and well clear of the roadway if you must walk along a highway, and never walk on a freeway but stay with the vehicle until help arrives.
Use an available sidewalk, or otherwise walk on the shoulder facing traffic.
Removing or defacing traffic signs is unlawful.
If walking for help becomes necessary, walk on the highway’s left side facing traffic, cross highways with great care and never cross an interstate.
Roadway walkers keep left facing traffic, cross at intersections using provided crosswalks, and obey applicable traffic laws.

result.summary: Snippets support walking on left/shoulder facing traffic when no sidewalk is available; no snippet describes sign shape, colour, or legend.
